subject: Provisioning & SAML evidence delivery for compliance review
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@summitcare-sec.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: audits@summitcare-sec.com
Date: 2027-03-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Evidence request: provisioning + SAML artifacts for SOC2/SIG

Hi Sean,

We're kicking off the evidence collection for SummitCare's SOC2 scoping. Can you please provide the following artifacts for Redwood's environment: 

- SAML metadata and a redacted sample SAML assertion (with subject and attribute statements)
- SCIM provisioning delta logs for the past 90 days (create/update/deactivate events)
- Role-to-permission mapping for services (CSV/XLSX) showing which roles map to which API permissions
- Admin/privileged access inventory and any just-in-time (JIT) or ephemeral access screenshots/docs
- A short mapping file that ties each artifact to SOC2 CC and SIG control IDs (e.g., CC6.1, SIG-AUTH-2)

We prefer secure upload (SFTP or your secure transfer URL). Target date for delivery: end of day 2027-03-05 (5 business days). If any artifacts require additional approvals, please let us know so we can adjust timelines.

Thanks,
Alice Monroe
Senior Security Assurance Manager
SummitCare Security

[Attachment request: please include sample filenames and formats]

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@summitcare-sec.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-01T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request: provisioning + SAML artifacts for SOC2/SIG

Alice — thanks for the list and the timeline. We're on it. High-level plan below: 

- SAML metadata + sample assertion: deliver by EOD 2027-03-02 (I will attach the metadata file and a redacted assertion)
- SCIM delta (90d) + role mapping: Monica will export and scrub PII, target 2027-03-02 afternoon
- Admin inventory + JIT evidence: Olga will pull admin snapshots and the JIT playbook, target 2027-03-03
- Audit log export / control mapping: Naomi will prepare a mapping doc tying artifacts to SOC2 CC and SIG controls, target 2027-03-03

Monica/Naomi/Olga — please use the secure transfer link below for uploads and flag any items that contain customer PII; redact or provide summary extracts as needed. If you need a different format, call it out in-thread.

Secure upload URL: https://redwood-secure-transfer.example.com/request/SCIM-90d (expires 2027-03-10)

Alice — if you prefer SFTP, we can create a temporary account; otherwise we'll post links to the secure bucket and drop attachments here.

Sean Gallagher
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

[Note to internal recipients: do not include full SSNs or raw customer message contents in attachments; redact before upload.]

From: monica.patel@redwood.com
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@summitcare-sec.com>, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-02T15:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request: provisioning + SAML artifacts for SOC2/SIG

Hi all — attaching exports and the role mapping spreadsheet. Files uploaded to secure transfer and attached below as stubs. I redacted any user email addresses tied to patients per the redaction guidance.

Attachments:
- scim-delta-90d.csv (CSV export; columns: timestamp,eventType,userId,source,actor)
- role-to-permission-20270302.xlsx (role | service | permission | notes)
- saml-metadata.xml (IdP/SP metadata used by Redwood)
- saml-sample-assertion.xml (redacted sample assertion; attributes unchanged except NameID hashed)

Notes:
- SCIM export includes create/update/deactivate; bulk provisioning events are in a separate batched file (we can provide if needed).
- Role spreadsheet maps application roles to the minimal set of API permissions. Let me know if you want a flattened permission list per user.

Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: scim-delta-90d.csv (text/csv), role-to-permission-20270302.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), saml-metadata.xml (application/xml), saml-sample-assertion.xml (application/xml)]

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-02T16:00:00Z
Subject: Internal: Audit log export uploaded (redacted)

FYI — I exported the authentication and provisioning audit logs (2026-12-01 to 2027-03-01) and uploaded a redacted bundle to the secure bucket: gs://redwood-evidence/2027/summitcare/audit-logs-redacted.tar.gz. The bundle contains:
- auth_events.csv (timestamp, event_type, user_hash, ip_city)
- provisioning_events.csv (SCIM events cross-referenced by user_hash)
- access_review_snapshots/ (PDF snapshots showing last quarterly reviews)

I removed IP addresses that map to internal support tooling and replaced user identifiers with consistent hashes to preserve traceability without PII. If SummitCare needs unredacted artifacts under an MSA addendum, we can initiate a protected transfer with additional approvals.

Naomi Feldman
Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@summitcare-sec.com>, audits@summitcare-sec.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-03T18:45:00Z
Subject: Delivering requested artifacts — Redwood evidence bundle

Alice / SummitCare team — please find the requested artifacts below. We've included a control mapping file and links to the secure bucket. If anything is missing or you want alternate formats, reply and we'll prioritize.

Delivered artifacts:
- saml-metadata.xml (attached)
- saml-sample-assertion.xml (attached, redacted)
- scim-delta-90d.csv (attached & secure bucket)
- role-to-permission-20270302.xlsx (attached)
- admin-access-inventory-20270302.pdf (attached; contains admin accounts, last review date, and JIT process screenshots)
- Audit logs bundle (redacted): gs://redwood-evidence/2027/summitcare/audit-logs-redacted.tar.gz

Control mapping: We mapped each artifact to SOC2 CC and SIG identifiers in the "role-to-permission" sheet (tab: control-mapping). Examples: role-to-permission -> CC6.1, SCIM delta -> SIG-PROV-3, audit logs -> CC7.2.

Upload links / downloads:
- Secure transfer landing: https://redwood-secure-transfer.example.com/download/SCIM-90d
- GCS bucket (read-only): gs://redwood-evidence/2027/summitcare/ (temporary creds provided via the secure transfer portal)

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether you'd like unredacted artifacts under a DPA addendum. We can also schedule a 30-minute walkthrough of the role mapping if useful for auditors — available 2027-03-04 or 2027-03-05 afternoon PST.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: saml-metadata.xml, saml-sample-assertion.xml, scim-delta-90d.csv, role-to-permission-20270302.xlsx, admin-access-inventory-20270302.pdf]
